quests.question: Convert to reported speech: He said, 'I finished the project.'
options: He said that he finished the project.
He said that he has finished the project.
He said that he had finished the project.
quests.correctAnswer: He said that he had finished the project.
quests.sentence: He said, 'I finished the project.'
quests.hint: A past simple verb in direct speech shifts even further back, to past perfect.
quests.explanation: 'Finished' (past simple) shifts to 'had finished' (past perfect) because the direct speech was already in the past.
